# Your Daily Briefing — Sunday 21 September

Yesterday was a solid rest day, and your body made good use of it. 8,200 steps kept you nicely active without overdoing it, and burning 2,509 kcal against your 2,300 target means you're in a modest deficit — exactly where you want to be on that 91.4kg to 80-85kg journey.

Your HRV at 91ms sits a touch below your 99-118ms baseline, but with a resting HR of just 51bpm and stress at a very relaxed 33/100, there's nothing alarming here. This looks like normal day-to-day variation rather than accumulated fatigue. Go ahead with today's planned session as normal — your body is ready.

Hit that 175g protein target today — on low-activity days it's tempting to eat lighter, but protein keeps your muscle mass protected while you're cutting. Prioritise it early rather than scrambling at dinner.
